_about: Hardware mapping (protocol v2). Detectors not listed under 'sensors' are virtual. Channels are indexes into the firmware's SENSORS[] / SIGNALS[] tables of that device: sensor channel 0 = GPIO27 (NS:D1), channel 1 = GPIO26 (NS:D2), both digital active-low IR modules; signal channel 0 = discrete R/Y/G outputs (G GPIO25, Y GPIO33, R GPIO32). Change 'port' to your ESP32's COM port (python -m smarttraffic.hw_smoke --list-ports).
